data.body: PANEL NOTE (round-1 canonical review, 2026-06-04): this convergence orphan is a 588e SUCCESS-MULTIPLIER, not only an a7aa concern. The enforce-flip (3ee4) makes FP-recovery LOAD-BEARING (3ebb DD4: each FP-recovery now needs a durable admin-exemption ledger write + admin attention). A non-converging review (the 29e7 6->3->3->3 oscillation this session) is the TRIGGER for FP-recovery, so the unwired convergence brake (review-convergence-check.sh, built-but-not-required) directly multiplies 588e's own friction/cost under enforce. Even though the ticket may live in a7aa, wiring review-convergence-check.sh into the review-sub-pr loop should be SEQUENCED relative to the enforce-flip. Historical precedent: PR-80/102/103 thrash motivated the ADR-0013 verifier (which addresses INVALID findings, not CYCLE non-convergence — hence the separate convergence-check). G-B (FP-recovery keys on llm-review not review-sub-pr) is folded here.
